lines.text: Tamil, one of the oldest living languages, is fading from temple walls.
So I built Ezhuthu, an apprentice.
A team of Strands agents reads the stone, letter by letter.
Lost letters? It checks thousands of parallels, and fills only when sure.
Nine in ten fills match the editors' restoration.
It explains the meaning, and teaches you to read it.
